verdict.reasoning: The reason (in Chinese) cites browser-based harness design, one document producing schematic/wiring/BOM-cut list/1:1 formboard, an MCP server and versioned part libraries, all of which appear on the page. It names concrete features and a professional audience, and it argues for a push.
